newsitem.title: PANAMA: Colombia kidnappers free Panamanian after 9 months.
newsitem.headline: Colombia kidnappers free Panamanian after 9 months.

text.p: A Panamanian businessman was released on Wednesday by his Colombian captors after nine months in captivity, a Panama police spokesman said.
Antonio Ramos, a merchant from a small town on Panama's border with Colombia in the dense Darien jungle, was released near a police station on the Colombian side of the border, the spokesman said.
"We have no idea who kidnapped him. We are still investigating. But (Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia) FARC guerrilla groups are always in that area," he said.
Colombian officials took Ramos into custody on Wednesday where Panama's National Air Service picked him up and flew him to Panama City.

Ramos was snatched from Boca de Cupe, a small town near the Colombian border that serves as a weigh station for Colombian drug traffickers, guerrilla groups and undocumented immigrants, the police spokesman said.
